quotes.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
quotes.flavor: Elspeth wanted answers. Xander needed a spy. Their paths were destined to cross.

quotes.name: Songs of the Damned
quotes.flavor: Not wind, but the breath of the dead.

quotes.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
quotes.flavor: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."

quotes.name: Hexing Squelcher
quotes.flavor: "Finally, a place where the ingredients are as potent as my magics!"

quotes.name: Gang Up
quotes.flavor:
"Well, who do we have here, Gorm?"
"No one, Virtus. No one at all."

quotes.name: Shore Snapper
quotes.flavor: Kathari, the sickly aven of Grixis, have learned that the corpses by the shoreline are more trap than treat.

quotes.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
quotes.flavor: Midwife to mothers and leader to all.

quotes.name: Starfield Mystic
quotes.flavor: "The realm of the gods opens before me!"

quotes.name: Midnight Reaper
quotes.flavor: No one welcomes his visit, yet all must grant him tribute.

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Abandon ship! No, grab the treasure first!"
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Neurok Prodigy
quotes.flavor: "Why should I be bound by rules when I can see so far beyond them?"

quotes.name: Chronomaton
quotes.flavor: On the third night, the villagers destroyed their clocks. The sounds of whirring gears and chiming metal held only dread for them.

quotes.name: Anguished Unmaking
quotes.flavor: Sorin had created Avacyn, so it was a cruelty beyond imagining, a pain beyond description, that it fell upon him to end her forever.

quotes.name: Extract from Darkness
quotes.flavor: If you want to wreak havoc above, sometimes it's best to look below.

quotes.name: Self-Reflection
quotes.flavor: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.

quotes.name: Teysa Karlov
quotes.flavor: While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.

quotes.name: Pouncing Jaguar
quotes.flavor: One pounce, she's hungry—you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs—you're in for a long day.

quotes.name: Ersatz Gnomes
quotes.flavor:
From jungle to sea, from sea to stone, from stone to field, from field to bone. What am I?
—Zhalfirin riddle

quotes.name: Bonds of Mortality
quotes.flavor: Jace discovered the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek to reality, but it was Nissa who could trace it on her world.

quotes.name: Paranormal Analyst
quotes.flavor: "If I've done this right, it should immobilize all spirits in the area. If I've done this wrong... you know what, let's just hope I did it right."

quotes.name: Raking Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"Raven's Run has awoken, and ravens will no longer cry in its branches."
—Roon Ghastbark

quotes.name: Rise from the Tides
quotes.flavor:
"Dear brother, it's sweet that you have chosen to share your toys with Ludevic, but I too have found some new playmates."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Arcane Sanctum
quotes.flavor:
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes."
—Tullus of Palandius

quotes.name: Narstad Scrapper
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, the principles of corpse animation applied to bloodless materials!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

quotes.name: Relentless Assault
quotes.flavor: "Mercy? Mercy is for the playground, not the battleground."

quotes.name: Klaw, Sonic Subjugator
quotes.flavor: "Listen to the sound of death. Hear the sound of your own cells exploding."

quotes.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
quotes.flavor:
"*Compleat* the faith, *compleat* the god."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Night Terrors
quotes.flavor: Innistrad is a place where dreams invade the mind and mere shadows exact a terrible toll.

quotes.name: Slight Malfunction
quotes.flavor:
"Attention, valued patrons. The Tilt-o-Squirrel is now closed."
—Astrotorium public address system

quotes.name: Snarling Warg
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: A shuddering howl broke from him, as if he were a captain summoning his pack to the assault.

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

quotes.name: Sliver Legion
quotes.flavor: Never meet your heroes. You might discover they're just another extension of your hive mind's consciousness.

quotes.name: Three Visits
quotes.flavor: Those who love the woods only wish to spread its majesty.

quotes.name: Hadana's Climb // Winged Temple of Orazca
quotes.flavor: Hadana seeks power in the service of peace.

quotes.name: Opt
quotes.flavor: 「最もよく叶う願いは、自らの運命を選択したいという願いだ。」

quotes.name: Shifting Sliver
quotes.flavor: Once the last few slivers the Riptide Project controlled were dead, there was nothing to keep the island from being completely overrun.

quotes.name: Damping Sphere
quotes.flavor: A Thran relic, it has spent ten thousand years doing absolutely nothing.

quotes.name: Thran Golem
quotes.flavor: The golems of the ancient Thran still draw power in ways that baffle the artificers of today.

quotes.name: Crimson Honor Guard
quotes.flavor: The finest soldiers aren't worth a whit without a set of hands to lead them and a set of eyes to guide them.

quotes.name: Goblin Chariot
quotes.flavor: The hardest part of his training is learning not to eat the boar.

quotes.name: Prized Unicorn
quotes.flavor:
"Friend and foe alike are irresistibly drawn to its beauty—the good, to their lasting reward, and the evil, to their brief and painful regret."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Shakedown Heavy
quotes.flavor: "Look, we both get what we want. I get your Halo. You get to keep your kneecaps."

quotes.name: Illusory Ambusher
quotes.flavor:
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

quotes.name: Lunar Insight
quotes.flavor:
"When wolves howl at the moon, I can't help but wonder: Does it answer? What secrets might it share when humans aren't listening?"
—Elinor, philosopher

quotes.name: Crisis of Conscience
quotes.flavor: "Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

quotes.name: Abuelo's Awakening
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Quintorius touched the old poncho he'd found. A rush of magic condensed into an Echo, and wise Abuelo stepped forth.

quotes.name: Cloudblazer
quotes.flavor: All the aether charts in the world can't compete with the trained eye of a talented scout.

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Knight
quotes.flavor:
"You returned a warrior. . . . Your hair was cut, your eye tattooed with the red triangle of war."
—"Love Song of Night and Day"

quotes.name: Worldsoul's Rage
quotes.flavor: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"

quotes.name: Spark Reaper
quotes.flavor:
"I know they're unstoppable fighters created to harvest souls—it's just they're so rude about it."
—Kaya

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: Hardened by their life in the haunted Llanowar Forest, these fierce beings are outcasts among elvenkind.

quotes.name: Tranquility
quotes.flavor:
"Peace will come, but whether born of harmony or entropy I cannot say."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Solemn Simulacrum
quotes.flavor: Making friends is hard work, even when you're poplar.

quotes.name: Ideas Unbound
quotes.flavor: The apprentice stared in puzzlement. "But Master, you finished writing those spells just yesterday. Don't you remember?" The jushi's heart froze.

quotes.name: Torch Courier
quotes.flavor: "Light a torch and deliver this letter" were his instructions, which he unfortunately reversed.

quotes.name: Wolfcaller's Howl
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge is a stain that only instinct and ferocity can cleanse."
—Drarg, wolfcaller

quotes.name: Culling Dais
quotes.flavor:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

quotes.name: Balduvian War-Makers
quotes.flavor:
"Those mewling Barbarians will cower before my righteous steel!"
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Embodiment of Agonies
quotes.flavor: "I feel your pain. It's exquisite."

quotes.name: Salt Vampire
quotes.flavor: After the collapse of their civilization, the people of M-113 became little more than predators, but they never abandoned their need for love.

quotes.name: Memnite
quotes.flavor: Reminders of Memnarch's reign still skirr across Mirrodin, reminiscent of his form if not his power.

quotes.name: Loxodon Gatekeeper
quotes.flavor: The gatekeepers are so fastidious that even the winds must wait to pass.

quotes.name: Font of Fertility
quotes.flavor: Drink deep, and know the path to the heart of the wilds.

quotes.name: Eternal Witness
quotes.flavor: She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.

quotes.name: Gorilla Berserkers
quotes.flavor:
"Beneath serenity may lie a hidden rage."
—Jaeuhl Carthalion, Juniper Order Advocate

quotes.name: Clay Statue
quotes.flavor: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant. After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

quotes.name: Hero of Iroas
quotes.flavor: "My left has felled a cyclops. My right has slain a giant. I bring both to every fight."

quotes.name: Long-Forgotten Gohei
quotes.flavor: Long ago, the priests would wave the gohei to call down the gods. Now it lies forgotten, but the spirits still feel its pull.

quotes.name: Annihilate
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

quotes.name: Twilight Mire
quotes.flavor: As their roots soaked in a weak tea of bogwater and decay, the trees absorbed the essence of death into their living tissue.

quotes.name: Evolution Vat
quotes.flavor: The vats are self-contained worlds, bubbling and churning with unnatural speed, boiling down eons of change into moments.

quotes.name: Prophetic Prism
quotes.flavor: "The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."

quotes.name: Stormcatch Mentor
quotes.flavor: "Only novice mages burn their whiskers. So pay attention!"

quotes.name: Quicksilver Dagger
quotes.flavor: The dwarves call their quicksilver techniques "improvisational weaponsmithing."

quotes.name: Fishliver Oil
quotes.flavor: Then the maiden bade him cast off his robes and cover his body with fishliver oil, that he might safely follow her into the sea.

quotes.name: Lim-Dûl's Hex
quotes.flavor:
"The weak shall fall. The strong shall remain."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Suki, Courageous Rescuer
quotes.flavor: "I'm okay. Just finish the mission!"

quotes.name: Karok Wrangler
quotes.flavor:
"She showed up to class on a what?"
—Valentin, Witherbloom Dean

quotes.name: Plague Engineer
quotes.flavor:
"The lasting effects are invariably fatal."
—Phyrexian progress notes

quotes.name: Archangel
quotes.flavor: The sky rang with the cries of armored seraphs, and the darkness made a tactical retreat.

quotes.name: Saheeli's Artistry
quotes.flavor: "From the first touch, I know exactly what the metal wants to be."

quotes.name: Roast
quotes.flavor:
"Intruders in the lands of Atarka have but two choices: be consumed by fire, or be consumed by maw."
—Ulnok, Atarka shaman

quotes.name: True Conviction
quotes.flavor: Dozens of spells known only to the Auriok elders were lost, but the next generation, galvanized by war, devised even more potent magic.

quotes.name: Glint-Sleeve Artisan
quotes.flavor: "Shine bright, bolts tight."

quotes.name: Emberwilde Captain
quotes.flavor: "You are bold, challenger, but flammable."

quotes.name: Gloom Ripper
quotes.flavor: "I will not rest until I have excised the rot from this land."

quotes.name: Drownyard Temple
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"This is it! All the cryptoliths point here!"
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Cut a Deal
quotes.flavor:
"Abandon your selfish ambitions and become one with the Flesh Singularity."
—Elesh Norn

quotes.name: Charix, the Raging Isle
quotes.flavor: Zendikar's seas are deeper than anyone can fathom.

quotes.name: Improvised Armor
quotes.flavor: "I don't care if it's covered in rust, blood, or enemy insignias. If it'll stop an arrow, I'll take it."

quotes.name: Teferi's Protege
quotes.flavor: Teferi's legacy lives on in Tolaria through the study of time magic and a tradition of irrepressible mischief.

quotes.name: Medicine Bag
quotes.flavor:
"My medicine bag and I have treated countless wounds and illnesses. But never have I seen so many made so sick for so long. We will *never* eat Squee's cooking again."
—Orim, journal

quotes.name: Surge of Brilliance
quotes.flavor: "They may have superior numbers, but we have superior minds."

quotes.name: Felidar Cub
quotes.flavor: Felidars that make it through their first year of life can easily live to see a hundred years more.

quotes.name: Food Fight
quotes.flavor: With no time to gather weapons, the dwarves fought the redcaps with anything within reach.

quotes.name: Price of Betrayal
quotes.flavor: The moment Liliana defied Nicol Bolas, her contract was broken, and her life was forfeit. But she was free to choose her fate, and she decided it was worth the price.

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: You've heard rumors of bandits along the Coast Way, but your journey so far has even surprisingly uneventful.

quotes.name: Roar of Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"Yesterday's relics will determine the outcome of tomorrow's war."
—Ushanti, leonin seer

quotes.name: Demystify
quotes.flavor:
"Illusion is a crutch for those with no grounding in reality."
—Cho-Manno

quotes.name: Museum Nightwatch
quotes.flavor: "You there, halt! The gallery is closed. Wait—what are you doing?"

quotes.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
quotes.flavor: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

quotes.name: Hero in Training
quotes.flavor:
"Here at Avengers Academy, we'll show you how to control your powers and become the heroes of tomorrow."
—Hank Pym, Avengers Academy founder

quotes.name: Reconstruct History
quotes.flavor: ANIMUS INITIALIZING . . . LOADING MEMORY SEQUENCE.

quotes.name: Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder
quotes.flavor: Creator of life, bringer of death.

quotes.name: Don & Leo, Problem Solvers
quotes.flavor: "Hey, watch it, Leonardo. You're ruining my finish!"

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor: As Frodo put on the Ring and claimed it for his own, the Power in Barad-dûr was shaken, and the Tower trembled from its foundations to its proud and bitter crown.

quotes.name: Crazed Skirge
quotes.flavor: They are Phyrexia's couriers; the messages they carry are inscribed on their slick hides.

quotes.name: Down for Repairs
quotes.flavor: Safety twelfth.

quotes.name: Renegade Tactics
quotes.flavor: "Nothing against you. It's just that waiting for Consulate clearance was never really my thing."

quotes.name: Wight of the Reliquary
quotes.flavor: Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.

quotes.name: Presence of Gond
quotes.flavor: "Here lies Gond, hero of Safehold Taldwen. May he ever guide our quest."

quotes.name: Sky Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Like a strain of music: easy to remember but impossible to catch."
—Mirri of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Silverbluff Bridge
quotes.flavor: A good way to avoid getting your feet wet (and irradiated) as long as you're willing to contend with raiders, scavengers, and super mutants.

quotes.name: Sanctum of Tranquil Light
quotes.flavor:
An untroubled mind
Dwells in perfect harmony
With a peaceful heart.

quotes.name: Pyrite Spellbomb
quotes.flavor:
"Melt that which was never frozen."
—Spellbomb inscription

quotes.name: Kujar Seedsculptor
quotes.flavor: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

quotes.name: Containment Priest
quotes.flavor: Some protection requires a bit of finesse.

quotes.name: Broodcaller Scourge
quotes.flavor: Younger dragons bow to its will, not out of respect, but out of fear.

quotes.name: Drove of Elves
quotes.flavor: "The light of beauty protects our journeys through darkness."

quotes.name: Thaumatic Compass // Spires of Orazca
quotes.flavor:
". . . a cryptic objective."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Artifact construction required immense resources.

quotes.name: Savannah
quotes.flavor: 2017 North American Legacy Champion

quotes.name: Lord of the Accursed
quotes.flavor: The Curse of Wandering leaves only hatred.

quotes.name: Shock
quotes.flavor:
"I love lightning! It's my best invention since the rock."
—Toggo, goblin weaponsmith

quotes.name: Ghost Warden
quotes.flavor:
"I thought of fate as an iron lattice, intricate but rigidly unchangeable. That was until some force bent fate's bars to spare my life."
—Ilromov, traveling storyteller

quotes.name: Watchwolf
quotes.flavor: Only in Ravnica do the wolves watch the flock.

quotes.name: Titan's Strength
quotes.flavor: "One last push, and then my task is done."

quotes.name: Mycosynth Wellspring
quotes.flavor: The oil created the mycosynth. The mycosynth created New Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Cellar Door
quotes.flavor: As if anyone needed another reason to avoid dark, dank cellars.

quotes.name: Plasm Capture
quotes.flavor:
"Everything serves a purpose. Even you."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

quotes.name: You're Ambushed on the Road
quotes.flavor: "Hand over your loot and no one gets hurt!"

quotes.name: Brood Monitor
quotes.flavor: The tenderness of a mother. The pity of a mantis.

quotes.name: Containment Construct
quotes.flavor: Automated units are deployed to stabilize merge sites deemed too dangerous even for trained intercessors.

quotes.name: Abandon the Post
quotes.flavor: You don't have to outrun the werewolf; you only have to outrun your fellow guard.

quotes.name: Killer Cosplay
quotes.flavor:
"Ach! Hans, run! Get the camera. He's adorable!"
—Steffi Bobsdotter, next words

quotes.name: Whitemane Lion
quotes.flavor: Saltfield nomads call a sudden storm a "whitemane."

quotes.name: Platinum Angel
quotes.flavor: On shining argent wings she came, declaring that no harm would befall her charge.

quotes.name: Timmy, Power Gamer
quotes.flavor: "Just wait till I get my Leviathan . . . ."

quotes.name: Shadow Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the spirits that claim knowledge beyond the moon; beware the ritual that summons them."
—Edict of the Lunarch Council

quotes.name: Silent Observer
quotes.flavor: It's not just a feeling—you *are* being watched.

quotes.name: Falkenrath Noble
quotes.flavor: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

quotes.name: Thriving Isle
quotes.flavor: All the wonders of the natural world in one breathtaking microcosm.

quotes.name: Endless Atlas
quotes.flavor: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

quotes.name: Thrashing Brontodon
quotes.flavor: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

quotes.name: Illuminate History
quotes.flavor: "Look at the detail in this stonework! Professor, our assumptions about early Kathorran tool use may not be correct."

quotes.name: Callous Dismissal
quotes.flavor:
"They make it clear we are nothing to them."
—Lavinia

quotes.name: Mad Prophet
quotes.flavor: "There's no heron in the moon! It's a shrew, a five-legged shrew, with a voice like whispering thunder!"

quotes.name: Wall of Ice
quotes.flavor:
"And through the drifts the snowy cliffs/ Did send a dismal sheen:/ Nor shapes of men nor beasts we ken—/ The ice was all between."/
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Pest Control
quotes.flavor:
"How dare these varmints befoul the shining streets of Prosperity?"
—Baron Bertram Graywater

quotes.name: Streetwise Negotiator
quotes.flavor: Like the laws, the rules of engagement always seem to bend in the Brokers' favor.

quotes.name: Wolfir Avenger
quotes.flavor: Released from a dark curse and bound to a higher calling.

quotes.name: Furycalm Snarl
quotes.flavor: A seething locus of reverent rage.

quotes.name: Iron Star
quotes.flavor: Forged by a thousand flames.

quotes.name: Feat of Resistance
quotes.flavor: Dragons are extinct on Tarkir, but Abzan magic still emulates their endurance.

quotes.name: Desperate Ravings
quotes.flavor: Her mind was quite gone, yet she spoke nothing but truth.

quotes.name: Butcher of Malakir
quotes.flavor: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

quotes.name: Coral Merfolk
quotes.flavor: The coral merfolk delight in wrestling with their foes, skinning them alive on the razor-sharp edges of their reef.

quotes.name: Ghired, Mirror of the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "The Conclave was soft. The Clans were trapped beasts. Here in this untamed wilderness, nature can truly roam free."

quotes.name: Rishkar, Peema Renegade
quotes.flavor: "Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free."

quotes.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
quotes.flavor: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

quotes.name: The Last Ride
quotes.flavor: The rearview mirror showed Winter what awaited him should he fail.

quotes.name: Great Oak Guardian
quotes.flavor: His roots reach deep and grip hard.

quotes.name: Trumpeting Armodon
quotes.flavor: These are its last days. But it will not go quietly.

quotes.name: Goblin Tinkerer
quotes.flavor:
"Can they *do* that?"
—Imwita, Zhalfirin artificer, last words

quotes.name: Overcome
quotes.flavor:
"Forward! Until the horizon is ours!"
—Khemses, charioteer

quotes.name: High Tide
quotes.flavor: "There's nothing like the high seas to clear your head or escape pursuers."

quotes.name: Doomed Necromancer
quotes.flavor: Many necromancers share the same last words—the ones that conclude the undeath ritual.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.

quotes.name: Rootborn Defenses
quotes.flavor: "No harm can come to me while the Worldsoul shelters me."

quotes.name: Kraken Hatchling
quotes.flavor: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

quotes.name: Geist of the Lonely Vigil
quotes.flavor: The flicker of candlelight and the echo of hymns told the villagers that the monastery wasn't truly abandoned.

quotes.name: Disperse
quotes.flavor: It's pointless to hold on when you have nothing to hold on with.

quotes.name: Voracious Brood
quotes.flavor: "We are Brood. And soon you will be too."

quotes.name: Disinformation Campaign
quotes.flavor:
"People would sooner savor sweet lies than chew plain truths."
—Lazav

quotes.name: Prosperity
quotes.flavor:
"True riches are found in the mazes of the mind."
—Tamiyo, the Moon Sage

quotes.name: Mayhem Devil
quotes.flavor: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

quotes.name: Cliffhaven Sell-Sword
quotes.flavor: "I swing a sword. It's a simple life. A lot of adventurers just see me as some cheap muscle, but if my steel lets them return home with their lives and limbs intact, then I've done my job."

quotes.name: Wind Sail
quotes.flavor: It pays to be at home both on the sea *and* in the sky.

quotes.name: Sandcrafter Mage
quotes.flavor: With heat, sand can form a delicate work of art; with pressure, an impenetrable bulwark.

quotes.name: Scathe Zombies
quotes.flavor:
"They groaned, they stirred, they all uprose,
Nor spake, nor moved their eyes;
It had been strange, even in a dream,
To have seen those dead men rise."
—Samuel Coleridge, "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner"

quotes.name: Vigor Mortis
quotes.flavor: After fear and weakness rot away, that which remains is stronger than its living form.

quotes.name: Temporal Mastery
quotes.flavor: Time is a marvelous plaything.

quotes.name: Jared Carthalion, True Heir
quotes.flavor: "I'm here for what's mine."

quotes.name: Leonin Arbiter
quotes.flavor: "Our people are torn by infighting. Until the two sides reconcile, our laws can carry no meaning."

quotes.name: Anowon, the Ruin Thief
quotes.flavor: FLUENT IN ARCANE TONGUES. PREFERS MONEY TO DO THE TALKING.

quotes.name: Prize Pig
quotes.flavor: The habit of building farmhouses and barns began among the inhabitants of the Marish down by the Brandywine.

quotes.name: Kozilek, the Great Distortion
quotes.flavor: A void as cryptic as reality itself.

quotes.name: Forgotten Creation
quotes.flavor:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Wrap in Vigor
quotes.flavor: Some nature mages unknowingly took advantage of the temporal energies still swirling on Dominaria. What they mistook for healing magic was in fact the manipulation of time.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Headless Horseman
quotes.flavor:
". . . [T]he ghost rides forth to the scene of battle in nightly quest of his head . . . he sometimes passes along the Hollow, like a midnight blast . . ."
—Washington Irving, The Legend of Sleepy Hollow

quotes.name: Mossfire Egg
quotes.flavor:
"Can you feel your instincts overwhelm your reason?"
—Watnik, master glassblower

quotes.name: Syr Vondam, the Lucent
quotes.flavor: A new dawn, burning away the darkness.

quotes.name: Ulcerate
quotes.flavor:
"If it were merely lethal, that would be sufficient. The art, however, is in maximizing the suffering it causes."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Storm the Seedcore
quotes.flavor: In that moment, the fate of countless worlds rested with one dryad and a handful of the bravest Mirrodin had to offer.

quotes.name: Price of Progress
quotes.flavor: Enthusiasm can be tempered in the furnace of the earth.

quotes.name: Temur Tawnyback
quotes.flavor:
"He just kind of followed me home one day. I mean, could you say no to this face?"
—Karasi, Mistrise provisioner

quotes.name: Bladegriff Prototype
quotes.flavor: The new model has improved aerodynamics but introduced a few glitches in the targeting system.

quotes.name: Overgrown Farmland
quotes.flavor:
"Animals have ruled this planet for millions of years. Now it is our turn."
—Harrison Chase

quotes.name: Gray Ogre
quotes.flavor: The Ogre philosopher Gnerdel believed the purpose of life was to live as high on the food chain as possible. She refused to eat vegetarians, and preferred to live entirely on creatures that preyed on sentient beings.

quotes.name: Oaken Siren
quotes.flavor: The ship's carpenter adorned the figurehead with a small cosmium gem, never expecting the figurehead to take flight.

quotes.name: Port Town
quotes.flavor:
"The excitement here has reached a fever pitch as the opening ceremony gets under way!"
—Blitzball announcer

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: There were no tombstones in orochi territory. Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Aethergeode Miner
quotes.flavor: Gremlins in the wild feed on nodules of pure aether, which are also prized by miners.

quotes.name: Cunning Breezedancer
quotes.flavor:
"That which is beautiful in form can also be deadly."
—Ishai, Ojutai dragonspeaker

quotes.name: Benalish Sleeper
quotes.flavor: Even he didn't know what he was until he felt his skin shifting and splitting, his mind overtaken by a chaos of whispers.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Dread Drone
quotes.flavor: Each Eldrazi ancient spawned a lineage of horrors in unfathomable shapes.

quotes.name: Abzan Falconer
quotes.flavor: The fastest way across the dunes is above.

quotes.name: Spitfire Lagac
quotes.flavor:
"If you hear a choking sort of cough, it's about to get really hot."
—Raff Slugeater, goblin shortcutter

quotes.name: Trickster's Elk
quotes.flavor:
"Wait. Is *that* one Dad?"
—Rowan Kenrith, to Will

quotes.name: Lyev Decree
quotes.flavor: The Azorius have so many codes and statutes that you're always in violation of one of them.

quotes.name: Knight of Stromgald
quotes.flavor:
"Kjeldorans should rule supreme, and to the rest, death!"
—Avram Garrisson, leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Sacred Foundry
quotes.flavor:
"Log 2.2.119: Kiln, known for its blazing forges and ancient lava seeps. The footing may be treacherous, but the metallurgy is grand!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

quotes.name: Sphinx's Revelation
quotes.flavor:
"Our secrets lie in the desert beyond the Hekma. But finding them will not be your challenge; living with the knowledge will be."
—Samut, to Basri

quotes.name: Rise from the Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Death is no excuse for disobedience."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Torpor Orb
quotes.flavor:
"Phyrexia is certainly dangerous, but I have to admire some of its innovations."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Purple Pentapus
quotes.flavor: Useful for whipping up a fictional plague in a pinch.

quotes.name: Desertion
quotes.flavor: First the insult, then the injury.

quotes.name: Mind Stone
quotes.flavor: What is mana but possibility, an idea not yet given form?

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Skim all the gold and magic rocks you want, but if I see one greasy fingerprint on my new boots, you'll be drinking bilgewater for a month."
—Note from Captain Lannery Storm

quotes.name: Suki, Kyoshi Warrior
quotes.flavor: "Hoping for another dance lesson?"

quotes.name: Chandra's Emberling
quotes.flavor: When Chandra needed to summon a chaotic distraction, only one form came to mind.

quotes.name: Persist
quotes.flavor: In the tight-knit doun of Mistmeadow, death is less important than duty.

quotes.name: Whiptail Wurm
quotes.flavor: It's hard to say for certain which end is more dangerous.

quotes.name: Altar of the Brood
quotes.flavor: Supplicants offer flesh and silver, flowers and blood. The altar takes what it will, eyes gleaming with unspoken promises.

quotes.name: Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt
quotes.flavor:
"Here below the hedron fields, souls and secrets lie entombed."
—Vivias, Witch Vessel

quotes.name: Scurry of Gremlins
quotes.flavor: A whiff of aether brings the horde out of hiding.

quotes.name: River Bear
quotes.flavor: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

quotes.name: Goblin Cratermaker
quotes.flavor:
"But the Orcs have brought a devilry from Orthanc."
—Aragorn

quotes.name: Vanguard Seraph
quotes.flavor: She guides expedition parties through the perilous floating ruins of Zendikar's ancient empires.

quotes.name: Enatu Golem
quotes.flavor: Golems conjured from the debris of Enatu Temple provided a sturdy but expendable first line of defense against the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Eviscerate
quotes.flavor:
"Fear the dark if you must, but don't mistake sunlight for safety."
—Josu Vess

quotes.name: Swarmyard
quotes.flavor: Where scavengers nest in hollowed-out rib cages and chittering crawlers peer from empty eye sockets, few dare to trespass.

quotes.name: Xu-Ifit, Osteoharmonist
quotes.flavor: "Tear away the rotten flesh of 'reality' and behold the pristine bones of Truth."

quotes.name: Reality Shift
quotes.flavor: Advanced Dungeons & Dragons: Dungeon Master Guide, *2nd Edition (1989)*

quotes.name: Eastern Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"There is no worse enemy. His passion for death doesn't just border on insanity, it wallows in it."
—The Southern Paladin

quotes.name: Propeller Pioneer
quotes.flavor: "The sky isn't the limit. It's the starting point."

quotes.name: Fire Elemental
quotes.flavor: Fire Elementals are ruthless infernos, annihilating and consuming their foes in a frenzied holocaust. Crackling and blazing, they sear swift, terrible paths, leaving the land charred and scorched in their wake.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rebirth
quotes.flavor: As long as one drop of the oil exists, the joyous work continues.

quotes.name: Nettle Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Though Shadowmoor's monster-haunted wilds beckon, she never leaves her post.

quotes.name: Carrion Feeder
quotes.flavor: Stinking of rot, it leaps between gravestones in search of its next meal.

quotes.name: Naomi, Pillar of Order
quotes.flavor: "Progress comes only when we rise above our petty quarrels."

quotes.name: Horned Cheetah
quotes.flavor: "I think she wants us to eat it," said Squee, staring at the oily carcass the cheetah had dragged to their fire.

quotes.name: Pestilence Demon
quotes.flavor: "I have schemed too long to be supplanted by dead gods. If I cannot have this world, no one can."

quotes.name: University Campus
quotes.flavor: The students and faculty of Empire State University are at the forefront of scientific research...and related pursuits.

quotes.name: Inspiring Roar
quotes.flavor:
"This is about more than aether or inventions. Tezzeret's schemes must be stopped!"
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Vindicate
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen entire civilizations rise and fall. You mortals are but dust to me."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Kazandu Mammoth // Kazandu Valley
quotes.flavor:
"The elves stick to the trees. Here, where the trees welcome the sky and leave room for grazing herds—this is our land."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller

quotes.name: Hurricane
quotes.flavor:
"This was quite possibly the least pleasant occurrence on the entire expedition."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Kessig Naturalist // Lord of the Ulvenwald
quotes.flavor: "Far from home, little one? I know the feeling."

quotes.name: Villainous Wealth
quotes.flavor: Some Robber Barons Get Just Desserts, Others Just Deserted

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: "You are beneath contempt. Your lineage will be forgotten."

quotes.name: Jhessian Balmgiver
quotes.flavor: "You have two choices: heed my advice now or need my healing later."

quotes.name: Hinata, Dawn-Crowned
quotes.flavor: Hope races on sunlit hooves.

quotes.name: Black Knight
quotes.flavor: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Cinder Elemental
quotes.flavor: Their rage can grow to such proportions that they explode in a cloud of fire.

quotes.name: Lifespinner
quotes.flavor:
"The husk splits like a madman's smile And mystery steps forth."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

quotes.name: Starlight
quotes.flavor: Stars are like coins dropped into the night: their light buys safe passage.

quotes.name: Frog Tongue
quotes.flavor: "But *why* can't I get one?" sniveled Squee. "All da bugs here got wings."

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.flavor:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Mercenaries
quotes.flavor:
"Blasted amateurs! Doesn't the queen think we can fight well enough on our own?"
—Avram Garrisson, Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

quotes.name: Famine
quotes.flavor:
"Better to starve to death than be bored to death."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Archetype of Imagination
quotes.flavor:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

quotes.name: Beast of Burden
quotes.flavor: The heavier the load, the harder it works.

quotes.name: Auratog
quotes.flavor: The auratog enjoys eating its wards.

quotes.name: Pariah
quotes.flavor: "It is *not* sad," Radiant chided the lesser angel. "It is right. Every society must have its outcasts."

quotes.name: Loyal Apprentice
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: Those with knowledge are wise to listen to those with imagination.

quotes.name: Rydia's Return
quotes.flavor:
"Are you okay? You should be able to move now."
—Rydia, Summoner of Mist

quotes.name: Apprentice Necromancer
quotes.flavor: A mage willing to dedicate his life to his craft.

quotes.name: Kirk, Enterprising Captain
quotes.flavor: "Risk is our business."

quotes.name: Stormsplitter
quotes.flavor:
"There was a bold young otterfolk / Who sailed for parts unknown, / Ignored the words her elders spoke, / And crewed the ship alone."
—*Songs from Upstream*

quotes.name: Sword-Point Diplomacy
quotes.flavor: "Take my blood if you want. Just don't take my gold!"

quotes.name: Lightning Diadem
quotes.flavor: "I fight for Keranos and for mortals. I see no contradiction."

quotes.name: Eye of Vecna
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: "I see all things as they truly are! I see . . . decay in all flesh, and betrayal in every heart."

quotes.name: Supreme Verdict
quotes.flavor: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

quotes.name: Ihsan's Shade
quotes.flavor:
"Ihsan, the weak. Ihsan, the fallen. Ihsan, the betrayer. He has brought shame to the Serra paladins where none existed before. May his suffering equal his betrayal."
—Baris, Serra inquisitor

quotes.name: The Shire
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"You must start somewhere and have some roots, and the soil of the Shire is deep."
—Merry

quotes.name: Fleshgrafter
quotes.flavor: Necrogen enflames certain emotional centers in the Morioks' brains: hate, aggression, and especially greed.

quotes.name: Shape Stealer
quotes.flavor:
"Stand back. I know just what to do."
—Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker

quotes.name: Kagemaro's Clutch
quotes.flavor: The mist was thick, cloying, and constricting. Shiro fought his way to fresh air only to look back and see his comrades fallen on the battlefield behind him.

quotes.name: Hedron Matrix
quotes.flavor: The hedrons awoke along with the Eldrazi, forming superstructures that radiated overwhelming magic.

quotes.name: Atzocan Archer
quotes.flavor: His arrows are fletched with feathers from the greatest of the winged dinosaurs.

quotes.name: Pillage
quotes.flavor:
"Were they to reduce us to ash, we would clog their throats and sting their eyes in payment."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

quotes.name: Scatter the Seeds
quotes.flavor: From the seeds of faith, great forests grow.

quotes.name: Sage of the Inward Eye
quotes.flavor: "No one petal claims beauty for the lotus."

quotes.name: Wall of Omens
quotes.flavor:
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi."
—Expedition journal entry

quotes.name: Falkenrath Noble
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "I often think on how excited they must feel to be chosen as my prey."

quotes.name: Hidden Herbalists
quotes.flavor: In the cellars beneath Narnam House, a strange and deadly garden grows.

quotes.name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
quotes.flavor: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

quotes.name: Filigree Angel
quotes.flavor: "I craved enlightenment, and Crucius's etherium opened my eyes. I would share my sight with you, but first you must believe."

quotes.name: Nivix Guildmage
quotes.flavor: "The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."

quotes.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
quotes.flavor: Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.

quotes.name: Blightreaper Thallid // Blightsower Thallid
quotes.flavor: Then one day, Mudcreep started to feel funny itself.

quotes.name: Cryptolith Rite
quotes.flavor: The chant was incomprehensible, but its power was unmistakable.

quotes.name: By Force
quotes.flavor:
"Dissent? Your gods can't even begin to comprehend the dissent that's about to happen here!"
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Relentless Raptor
quotes.flavor: As the battle for Orazca unfolded, the contenders discovered that others had already staked a claim.

quotes.name: Cosmic Hunger
quotes.flavor: The Copper Host sought only the strongest converts. In Koma, it found perfection.

quotes.name: Rock Soldiers
quotes.flavor: Catching enemies between a rock and a hard place.

quotes.name: Parallel Lives
quotes.flavor:
"Brave Syr Armont mused: Was the elves' true nature that of day's civility or night's savagery? Could such bestial rage be bestowed by curse alone?"
—*Curse of the Werefox*

quotes.name: Orazca Frillback
quotes.flavor: The frillbacks of Orazca soak up the sun on their tall spinal fins. They look slow and sleepy—until they catch the scent of prey.

quotes.name: Quiet Speculation
quotes.flavor:
"The best foresight is hindsight."
—Empress Llawan

quotes.name: Blasphemous Act
quotes.flavor:
"Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Harvesttide Sentry
quotes.flavor: She patrols the darkness so that others can forget their worries for one bright evening.

quotes.name: Infuse
quotes.flavor:
"The potential for change lies in all things. Know a thing's nature, know its possibilities, and know it anew."
—Gustha Ebbasdotter, Kjeldoran Royal Mage

quotes.name: Ragefire
quotes.flavor: "Your precious laws can't save you now!"

quotes.name: Anaba Bodyguard
quotes.flavor:
"Not someone to pick a fight with, unless you're fond of pain."
—Halina, Dwarven Trader

quotes.name: Giant Scorpion
quotes.flavor: Its sting hurts, but death is strangely painless.

quotes.name: Zimone, Quandrix Prodigy
quotes.flavor: "What are they complaining about? It's not like axiomatic leyline paratrigonometrics is hard."

quotes.name: Sylvan Tutor
quotes.flavor: The whole of creation stood transfixed, silenced by the weight of anticipation.

quotes.name: Flame Channeler // Embodiment of Flame
quotes.flavor: At the edge of night, on the cusp of winter, the allure of fire grows ever stronger.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: More than one mage was driven insane by the sound of the Millstone relentlessly grinding away.

quotes.name: Damn
quotes.flavor: "So this is the power of the Ring of the Lucii..."

quotes.name: Patchwork Gnomes
quotes.flavor:
"Just when I get them working, they always start fighting and tearing at each other for spare parts."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Toxic Deluge
quotes.flavor:
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds."
—Esara, healer adept

quotes.name: Kraken Hatchling
quotes.flavor: A spike and a maul are needed to crack their shells, but the taste is worth the effort.

quotes.name: Fog
quotes.flavor: It's hard enough to find your way through uncharted wilderness when you can see the tip of your nose.

quotes.name: Grapeshot Catapult
quotes.flavor: Recent research suggests these creatures were invented by Urza's and Mishra's original master, Tocasia, and that both brothers used them.

quotes.name: Goldberry, River-Daughter
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Fear nothing! For tonight you are under the roof of Tom Bombadil."

quotes.name: Leatherback Baloth
quotes.flavor: Heavy enough to withstand the Roil, leatherback skeletons are havens for travelers in storms and landshifts.

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor:
"It has a quickness about it that seems unnatural for its large size, yet its hunger is about right."
—Endril, Kalonian naturalist

quotes.name: Kujar Seedsculptor
quotes.flavor: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

quotes.name: Umbra Mystic
quotes.flavor: "I have found the courage to face death—twice, if I must."

quotes.name: Windfall
quotes.flavor: "Rich" is a relative term.

quotes.name: Hunger of the Howlpack
quotes.flavor:
"Werewolves are an unholy mix of a predator's instinct and a human's hatred."
—Alena, trapper of Kessig

quotes.name: Conflux
quotes.flavor: After years of world-bending machinations, Bolas's triumph is at hand.

quotes.name: Ancestral Vengeance
quotes.flavor: The defenses of the Abzan extend well beyond the walls of their fortresses.

quotes.name: Wojek Investigator
quotes.flavor: "Well, this clearly didn't come from anyone I know..."

quotes.name: Divine Verdict
quotes.flavor: "Guilty."

quotes.name: Spectral Procession
quotes.flavor:
"The dead have it easy. They suffer no more. If breaking their rest helps the living, so be it."
—Olka, mistmeadow witch

quotes.name: Hail Storm
quotes.flavor:
"If they can't take the hail, they'd better stay home."
—Arna Kennerüd, skycaptain

quotes.name: Even the Odds
quotes.flavor:
"They who fall singing the battle hymn of Benalia go not unavenged."
—Adom Capashen, Benalish commander

quotes.name: Bog Raiders
quotes.flavor: Those who live amid decay must expect scavengers.

quotes.name: Arrest
quotes.flavor: Bladehold houses a rogues' gallery filled with the living "statues" of the worst enemies of the Auriok.

quotes.name: Feed the Clan
quotes.flavor: The Temur believe three things only are needed in life: a hot fire, a full belly, and a strong companion.

quotes.name: Citadel Gate
quotes.flavor: A beacon of order and safety, for those who can afford it.

quotes.name: Tenured Inkcaster
quotes.flavor: "Ah, another future archmage for my collection."

quotes.name: Bitterblossom
quotes.flavor: In Lorwyn's brief evenings, the sun pauses at the horizon long enough for a certain species of violet to bloom with the fragrance of mischief.

quotes.name: Basim Ibn Ishaq
quotes.flavor: Haunted by memories he never had, of a family that was never his.

quotes.name: Jidoor, Aristocratic Capital // Overture
quotes.flavor:
"You're the spitting image of Maria!"
—Jidoor resident

quotes.name: Colossal Whale
quotes.flavor:
"And in the night from Otherworld beyond the Sea there strong and free a storm arose . . ."
—*Song of Eärendil*

quotes.name: Fencing Ace
quotes.flavor: "Go find yourself a couple of friends, and bring me a blindfold. Then we might have a fair fight."

quotes.name: Mystic Monastery
quotes.flavor: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"The Ñoldor, perhaps Fëanor himself, wrought the *palantíri* in days so long ago that the time cannot be measured in years."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Blatant Thievery
quotes.flavor: Centuries of association with the Sun Empire have taught the dinosaurs that shiny things are important.

quotes.name: Final Fortune
quotes.flavor:
Want all, lose all.
—Zhalfirin aphorism

quotes.name: Emperor Crocodile
quotes.flavor: The king of Yavimaya's waters pays constant attention to his subjects . . . and thrives on their adulation.

quotes.name: Temporal Mastery
quotes.flavor: Time is a marvelous plaything.

quotes.name: Stormcloud Spirit
quotes.set_name: Global Series Jiang Yanggu & Mu Yanling
quotes.flavor: The spirits of all the rivers and oceans came together as an unstoppable force, unleashing their fury as lightning and thunder.

quotes.name: Mercurial Pretender
quotes.flavor: The king went off to find himself. Imagine his terror when he succeeded.

quotes.name: Fungus Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"When a sliver of this breed enters the hive, the others claw each other in frenzied fits, thereby ensuring their rapid growth."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.

quotes.name: Pongify
quotes.flavor: Some spellcrafting mistakes go on to become spells of their own.

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Luminous Broodmoth
quotes.flavor: It soars through currents of moonbeams to give hope to the forsaken.

quotes.name: Word of Undoing
quotes.flavor:
"It was in Urza's journals that I finally found the secret at the core of the summonings."
—Journal, author unknown

quotes.name: Splendid Genesis
quotes.flavor:
She discovered with great delight that one does not love one's children because they are one's children but because of the friendship formed while raising them.
Gabriel Garciá Márquez

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor:
"But I am going to Mordor," said Frodo.
"I know that well enough," said Sam. "Of course you are. And I'm coming with you."

quotes.name: Ruthless Disposal
quotes.flavor:
"Do try to pull your weight, Geralf. I feel like I'm doing everything."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Ral's Reinforcements
quotes.flavor: "Good thing maintenance never got around to decatalyzing the bithermic plasma displacement conduits!"

quotes.name: Mantis Engine
quotes.flavor:
"It's a clever design. You should look closely at its gearing after it swallows your head."
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Warden of Evos Isle
quotes.flavor: On Evos Isle, the swift and formidable aven enforce the will of the ruling sphinxes.

quotes.name: Taoist Hermit
quotes.flavor: Taoists chose to be hermits for many reasons, but all shared one unchanging goal: to follow the Tao.

quotes.name: Fateful Absence
quotes.flavor: Sensing a plot, Sorin raced to his grandfather's resting-crypt. But someone else had gotten there first.

quotes.name: Murder
quotes.flavor: Laughter and conversation trailed off as the revelers gathered around Zegana's body. Three things quickly became clear: it was a murder, the killer was likely among them, and Teysa's party was definitely over.

quotes.name: Tromp the Domains
quotes.flavor: Ground into the footprints of the ravaging herd were clumps of salt from Benalia, moss from Llanowar, dust from Hurloon, and ash from as far as Urborg.

quotes.name: Reprobation
quotes.flavor: There was a time all craven beasts cowered before Avacyn's divine might.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor:
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot.
—Llanowar penalty for trespassing

quotes.name: Darien, King of Kjeldor
quotes.flavor:
"With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor. Those who followed were known as the kings of New Argive."
—*Kjeldor: Ice Civilization*

quotes.name: Flayed One
quotes.flavor: Those suspected of carrying the flayer curse are summarily banished, lest the corruption spread to other Necrons.

quotes.name: Zalto, Fire Giant Duke
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.

quotes.name: Adarkar Wastes
quotes.flavor: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

quotes.name: Innocent Blood
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

quotes.name: Infernal Scarring
quotes.flavor: One who is marked by a demon in life is sure to be remembered as one in death.

quotes.name: Akroma's Devoted
quotes.flavor: Akroma asked for only one thing from her troops: unwavering, unconditional loyalty.

quotes.name: Captain Sisay
quotes.flavor: Her leadership forged the *Weatherlight*'s finest crew.

quotes.name: Dread Rider
quotes.flavor:
"What kind of monstrous grave robber leaves the treasures, but takes the bodies?"
—Fjall, Beskir elder

quotes.name: Liliana's Mastery
quotes.flavor: "There are so many of them. It seems they've just been waiting for someone to serve."

quotes.name: Undersea Invader
quotes.flavor:
"The currents are strange today, and the fish are fearful. Something's stirring in the depths."
—Rathstaf, Kannah fisherman

quotes.name: Felidar Cub
quotes.flavor: Felidars that make it through their first year of life can easily live to see a hundred years more.

quotes.name: Knight of the Kitchen Sink
quotes.flavor: "Whew. For a minute, I thought I'd forgotten the juicer."

quotes.name: Zombie Master
quotes.flavor: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

quotes.name: Plaguecrafter
quotes.flavor: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

quotes.name: Brass Squire
quotes.flavor:
"I admire it. Few pull off pluck and subservience at the same time."
—Ezuri, renegade leader

quotes.name: Goliath Paladin
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Why do you cower in the darkness, little gnolls? If you would challenge me, step into the light."

quotes.name: Ironclad Krovod
quotes.flavor:
"We need to block the exits from the plaza! What's big, heavy, and available?"
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Pyretic Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Sometimes, students, rite makes might."
—Mother Luti

quotes.name: Whirlwind
quotes.flavor: Urza tried to rule the air, but Gaea taught him that she controlled all the elements.

quotes.name: Nantuko Mentor
quotes.flavor:
That which grows without roots cannot be uprooted.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

quotes.name: Mirran Crusader
quotes.flavor: A symbol of what Mirrodin once was and hope for what it will be again.

quotes.name: Goblin Balloon Brigade
quotes.flavor: "From up here we can drop rocks and arrows and more rocks!" "Uh, yeah boss, but how do we get down?"

quotes.name: Martyr of Frost
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor:
"You know I accept only one currency here, and yet you have sought me out. Why now do you hesitate?"
—Xathrid demon

quotes.name: Typhoid Rats
quotes.flavor: Kidnappers caught in Havengul are given two choices: languish in prison or become rat catchers. The smart ones go to prison.

quotes.name: Gollum, Silent Slinker // Meager Meal
quotes.flavor: He rowed about quietly on the lake. Never a ripple did he make, not he.

quotes.name: Silent Arbiter
quotes.flavor: Scholars say that arbiters exist on every world, created by an unknown hand to enforce justice.

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: A beacon of prosperity to some, a shadow of oppression to others.

quotes.name: Opportunity
quotes.flavor: "Opportunity isn't something you wait for. It's something you create."

quotes.name: Golgari Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

quotes.name: Firewake Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"When establishing a new hive in hostile territory, slivers abandon all sense of individual self-preservation to ensure the queen's survival."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Hieroglyphic Illumination
quotes.flavor: "The answers are here. This is the way through the trial."

quotes.name: Sandstorm Charger
quotes.flavor:
"May our foes choke upon its horns!"
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Ferocious Werefox // Guard Change
quotes.flavor: Each night, the elves of Redtooth Keep transform into feral, monstrous beasts.

quotes.name: Demanding Dragon
quotes.flavor: A knight's devotion to their steed goes only so far.

quotes.name: Mishra's Domination
quotes.flavor: Power radiated from the Weakstone, binding the dragon engine to Mishra's command.

quotes.name: Living Destiny
quotes.flavor: "That our enemies are great only brings us greater hope."

quotes.name: Shattered Sanctum
quotes.flavor: The Quietus Cult holds their grim ceremonies in the dark places where unburied dead litter the ground.

quotes.name: Seasoned Buttoneer
quotes.flavor: Everyone comments on the buttons, but few appreciate the pedals.

quotes.name: Greater Werewolf
quotes.flavor:
"The wolf-things are no mere beasts, but the lieutenants of the Baron."
—Taysir

quotes.name: Boil
quotes.flavor: "When every reef is bared and every wave is dust—only then shall I rest."

quotes.name: Dream Beavers
quotes.flavor: "We've drained human life force for millennia. Then one day, turtles! Delectable! We'll suck you dry and spit out the shells!"

quotes.name: Deathcap Glade
quotes.flavor:
"Life is defined by change. When I shucked my flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection, it was not loss to me, merely a new state of being."
—Moseo, dean of the vein

quotes.name: Archivist of Oghma
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is the greatest tool of the mortal mind, outweighing anything made by mortal hands. Before anything else can exist, the idea must exist."

quotes.name: Killer Whale
quotes.flavor: Hunger is like the sea: deep, endless, and unforgiving.

quotes.name: Goblin S.W.A.T. Team
quotes.flavor: They put the "special" in special weapons and tactics.

quotes.name: Celeborn the Wise
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: His eyes were keen as lances in starlight, and yet profound, the wells of deep memory.

quotes.name: Doubling Cube // Doubling Cube
quotes.flavor:
"Freedom is the right of all sentient beings."
—Optimus Prime

quotes.name: Tymaret, the Murder King
quotes.flavor: His memories remained in the Underworld, but his cruelty crossed the Rivers with him.

quotes.name: Toxic Nim
quotes.flavor: The nim have become roving killers marshaled by whichever thane holds tenuous leadership.

quotes.name: Sigiled Sentinel
quotes.flavor: "Alara has been broken before. I will not let it break again."

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Idyllic Beachfront
quotes.flavor: In the tradition of the original Tolarian Academy, every Tolarian campus is built near a body of water.

quotes.name: Scouting Trek
quotes.flavor:
"I have chosen my path. Who will walk it with me?"
—Eladamri

quotes.name: Defy Death
quotes.flavor: Gisela cornered the murderous demon among the graves of the dead villagers. "A fitting end," she murmured as she raised her sword.

quotes.name: The Rhystic Storyteller
quotes.flavor: DISCARDED

quotes.name: Gruul Guildgate
quotes.flavor:
"Old turf. Powerful turf. Much good blood spilled here."
—Ruric Thar

quotes.name: Sword of the Chosen
quotes.flavor: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

quotes.name: Greater Forgeling
quotes.flavor: Few have seen the inner workings of Ravnica's furnaces, but neighboring districts catch brief glimpses in the horrors that escape the flames.

quotes.name: Butcher of Malakir
quotes.flavor: His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.

quotes.name: Lone Wolf
quotes.flavor: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

quotes.name: Browse
quotes.flavor:
"Once great literature—now great litter."
—Jaya Ballard, task mage

quotes.name: Borderland Ranger
quotes.flavor: "Only fools and bandits use roads."

quotes.name: The Prismatic Piper
quotes.flavor: It is everything and nothing.

quotes.name: Second Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"The cornfields promise a good yield this season."
—Radwick, farmer of Gatstaf

quotes.name: Lord of Atlantis
quotes.flavor: A master of tactics, the lord of Atlantis makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving to lead them.

quotes.name: Fortuitous Find
quotes.flavor: An aetherborn wastes neither time nor treasure.

quotes.name: Tinybones, Trinket Thief
quotes.flavor: Tinybones doesn't actually own a scooter so this art isn't canon. But can you imagine if he did?!

quotes.name: Jalum Tome
quotes.flavor:
"These glyphs describe a Thran device capable of controlling a machine army, but the dimensions make no sense. It's nearly the size of the Null Moon."
—Urza, diary

quotes.name: Shapesharer
quotes.flavor: One good mimic deserves another.

quotes.name: Thraben Standard Bearer
quotes.flavor: The uncorrupted rallied under Thalia's leadership and Sigarda's banner.

quotes.name: Gnarlback Rhino
quotes.flavor:
"I think it's trying to tell us that the forest is angry."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Gimbal, Gremlin Prodigy
quotes.flavor: You are what you eat, and everything he'd eaten was brilliant.

quotes.name: Quandrix Pledgemage
quotes.flavor: "The first step toward transcending physical limitations is discarding assumptions about what is possible."

quotes.name: Zalto, Fire Giant Duke
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Fire giants love to fight on a large scale, and Duke Zalto is one of the greatest warmongers of his age.

quotes.name: Nature's Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Adventurous Impulse
quotes.flavor:
「彼女の探検は、すべての探検と同様に、予期せぬ方向への小さな一步から始まった。」
—-探検者の遺言

quotes.name: Eaten Alive
quotes.flavor:
"If you hear a groaning noise in the cellar, don't investigate. Don't split up. Just lock the door and barricade it."
—Emili, guard captain

quotes.name: Quirion Explorer
quotes.flavor:
Fight with a friend at your back, steel in your hands, and magic in your veins.
—Quirion creed

quotes.name: Shields of Velis Vel
quotes.flavor: Changelings can alter shape based on what the beings around them desire most.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

quotes.name: Welkin Tern
quotes.flavor: It stops flying only as its life comes to an end.

quotes.name: War Priest of Thune
quotes.flavor: "Let nothing take away from the purity of swords clashing or of arrows taking flight toward the breast of evil."

quotes.name: Innocent Blood
quotes.flavor: Zombies mourn for the living and celebrate those who will soon be given the gift of death.

quotes.name: Blackcleave Cliffs
quotes.flavor: Where ambition meets industry, passion is poisoned by greed.

quotes.name: Tundra Wolves
quotes.flavor: I heard their eerie howling, the wolves calling their kindred across the frozen plains.

quotes.name: Talisman of Creativity
quotes.flavor: "Well? Isn't anyone going to ask what is it with the glasses?"

quotes.name: Glacial Floodplain
quotes.flavor:
"A cliff once rose from the surf here—until Bjora Dawn-Greeter declared that it was blocking her view and pulled it down bare-handed."
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Temporal Cleansing
quotes.flavor: Careless fae become lost in dreamstuff too sweet.

quotes.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
quotes.flavor: "Humans bring nothing but suffering and deceit. They are not welcome in my forest."

quotes.name: Alpha Tyrranax
quotes.flavor: Hunger seized the tyrranax, and the Sylvok's vision quest ended in disaster.

quotes.name: Mana Leak
quotes.flavor: The fatal flaw in every plan is the assumption that you know more than your enemy.

quotes.name: Spark Elemental
quotes.flavor: Vulshok shamans could never keep them alive for more than a few seconds, yet those few seconds seemed to be enough.

quotes.name: Stomping Ground
quotes.flavor:
"What we begin, the End-Raze will finish. Then we will dance in Ravnica's rubble."
—Nikya of the Old Ways

quotes.name: Inspiring Veteran
quotes.flavor: "I fight for my daughter, who may not set foot on a battlefield for many years. Remember who you fight for."

quotes.name: Akki Avalanchers
quotes.flavor: Among Godo's hordes, "beware of falling rocks" came to mean "akki live nearby."

quotes.name: Cosmic Epiphany
quotes.flavor:
"All knowledge, past and future, is etched upon reality. Every answer we seek is out there, hidden only by the limits of our minds."
—Jodah

quotes.name: Dungeon Delver
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: You're driven not by a lust for gold or baubles, but by the thrill of danger and the excitement of the unknown.

quotes.name: Mausoleum Guard
quotes.flavor: "Ghoulcallers trying to get in, geists trying to get out . . . . This duty is never dull."

quotes.name: Bruenor Battlehammer
quotes.flavor: The title of Man-At-Arms is earned through service, not inherited by name.

quotes.name: Elite Headhunter
quotes.flavor: Nothing remains of his foes but the gripping story of their downfall.

quotes.name: Knight of the Widget
quotes.flavor: His armor is lightweight titanium alloy, but his will is iron.

quotes.name: Sign in Blood
quotes.flavor: Little agonies pave the way to greater power.

quotes.name: Goblin Lore
quotes.flavor: "The coronation of King Numsgil, no . . . adventures of Tuktuk, no . . . the saga of Morpo the Bard, no! Where's *my* story?"

quotes.name: Azorius Herald
quotes.flavor:
"As peace should be—gentle yet unstoppable."
—Augustin IV

quotes.name: Repay in Kind
quotes.flavor: Sorin has gathered grudges for centuries, patiently awaiting the day he can exact the perfect vengeance.

quotes.name: Pyroclastic Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"Whoever thought of making mobile volcanoes was a genius."
—Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Barrow Witches
quotes.flavor:
"Taste the sweetness, breath for breath. Keep the balance, death for death."
—Barrow witch incantation

quotes.name: On Wings of Gold
quotes.flavor: The edge of Naktamun was once protected by Kefnet. The honored mummies who patrol it now do so in his image.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: The Sun Empire bends nature—rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.

quotes.name: Black Carriage
quotes.flavor:
"The Baron's drivers are also driven."
—Chandler

quotes.name: Time Wipe
quotes.flavor:
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Enshrouding Mist
quotes.flavor: True faith is letting the blade fall without parry. True cunning is using that moment to strike a deadly blow.

quotes.name: Island
quotes.flavor: As you sail past the imposing Seatower of Balduran, you realize that breaking your friend out of that prison will be much harder than you thought.

quotes.name: Silverback Ape
quotes.flavor: It does not wear a crown or sit on a throne of gold, but those who have witnessed its power hail it nonetheless.

quotes.name: Bitter Revelation
quotes.flavor:
"Here you lie then, Ugin. The corpses of worlds will join you in the tomb."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, called the Pretender

quotes.name: Hurloon Minotaur
quotes.flavor: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle. They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike. These hymns can last for days, filling the mountain valleys with their low, haunting sounds.

quotes.name: The Unspeakable
quotes.flavor: It is madness that drives men to seek forbidden knowledge, and madness has given it form.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Krenko's Command
quotes.flavor: Goblins are eager to follow orders, especially when those orders involve stealing, hurting, annoying, eating, destroying, or swearing.

quotes.name: Thirst for Knowledge
quotes.flavor: "To truly know something, you must become it. The trick is to not lose yourself in the process."

quotes.name: Curator of Mysteries
quotes.flavor: To consult a sphinx is a test in patience. Perhaps that's the point.

quotes.name: Ancient Spider
quotes.flavor: It outlived both king and castle.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
quotes.flavor:
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching
